premise_owner_stated: Future product work is frontend only. Backend and overall problem validation must be planned now, before that split takes effect.
consequence: Anything not settled before the split becomes unfixable by the remaining team. This plan lists what must be closed, and what is safe to leave open.

must_close_before_frontend_only.item: D5 — dimension appearing in both secondary and overall_profile
must_close_before_frontend_only.why_now: It changes what the user sees in two slots simultaneously. A frontend-only team cannot decide it, because it is an inference-layer rule, not a display choice.
options: suppress the profile entry when the dimension already has a secondary representative
keep both as intentional role separation
keep both, mark the profile entry as already represented
must_close_before_frontend_only.already_implemented_as: suppress_profile_when_secondary flag, defaulting to current behaviour

must_close_before_frontend_only.item: Output shape frozen into a schema the frontend can build against
must_close_before_frontend_only.why_now: main <=3, secondary <=2, overall_profile <=3 is settled but has no versioned schema. The frontend needs field names, cardinalities and the empty cases.
critical_empty_cases: main below 3, which is 76% of records
secondary empty when no dimension is uncovered
overall_profile empty when no dimension is activated

must_close_before_frontend_only.item: Bilingual label coverage for every emittable concept
must_close_before_frontend_only.why_now: The product is CN/EN. The six new broad concepts carry labels. The 59 R9 descriptors do not, and the frontend cannot invent them.
must_close_before_frontend_only.gap: 59 named descriptors plus 9 profile directions need zhHans labels. The public repo already carries them for 24 descriptors under CC BY 4.0 and can seed this.

must_close_before_frontend_only.item: Question and option wording for C0, C1, Q0 through Q5
must_close_before_frontend_only.why_now: PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1 fixes the flow structure but not the wording. A frontend-only team would either invent it or block.
must_close_before_frontend_only.constraint_from_contract: exactly one question may carry 'none of the above'; others at most 'uncertain'

must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.state: 0 edges. 312 of 632 occurrences carry a REQUIRES_RELATION_EDGE status.
must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.unlocks: within-class discrimination, and secondary populated by specific words rather than class representatives
must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.note: Backend work. Does not block frontend, because the output shape is unchanged either way.

must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.item: Attribute extension to the remaining 45 descriptors
must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.state: 24 descriptors carry six CC BY 4.0 attributes; 14 overlap the registry

must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.item: Corpus growth beyond the measured ceiling
must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.state: capture ceiling roughly 7000, on-subject conversion 0.073 groups per candidate
must_plan_but_can_run_after_the_split.note: Only matters if a learned component returns. Not on the current path.

explicitly_out_of_scope_now.reason: Measured supervision cannot support parameter fitting, and the owner confirmed even 250 is not a safe floor.
Mathematically impossible at the current topology. 57 of 59 descriptors carry exactly one dimension.

validation_that_must_be_planned_now.problem: The only evaluation harness runs against R8/R9 frozen states, and the root private artifacts are lost.
validation_that_must_be_planned_now.consequence: No further measurement against the historical baseline is possible. Every future comparison must be against a NEW baseline captured from the repaired generator.
validation_that_must_be_planned_now.action_required_before_the_split: Freeze a new evaluation baseline from output_generator_round2 over a committed state fixture, so the frontend team inherits something they can regression-test against.
validation_that_must_be_planned_now.note: Without this the project loses the ability to detect its own regressions, which is worse than any single missing artefact.

operational_finding.finding: OWNER_CONTROLLED_STORAGE resolved to /private/tmp, a directory the operating system clears. Roughly 34 MB of per-case research detail existed there as a single copy with no backup.
operational_finding.action_taken: Remaining files copied to ~/coffee-flavor-r9-private-backup. Five declared hashes verified intact. Originals untouched.
operational_finding.recommendation: Choose a durable location and change the --private-output default. Any script whose output is referenced by a committed hash must not write to a temp directory.
